item.title: Attorney General Ellison sues to block unprecedented changes to Medicaid eligibility that will kick Minnesotans off healthcare
item.description:
Publication Date: November 06, 2026

H.R. 1 compels states to enforce unprecedented new work requirements or lose all Medicaid funding — fundamentally changes Medicaid from a healthcare program to a work program that leverages healthcare for compliance

https://www.ag.state.mn.us/Office/Communications/2026/11/06_Medicaid-Eligibility.asp

item.title: Attorney General Ellison wins lawsuit to protect crime-fighting grants from illegal Trump conditions
item.description:
Publication Date: November 06, 2026

Court permanently blocks Trump Administration from illegally imposing conditions related to immigration enforcement on public-safety grants that Congress authorized

https://www.ag.state.mn.us/Office/Communications/2026/11/06_VOCA.asp

item.title: Attorney General Ellison opposes Trump attack on tax-exempt status for private schools with non-discrimination policies
item.description:
Publication Date: November 06, 2026

AG Ellison co-leads opposition to proposed IRS rule that would deny or revoke tax exemption to as many as 18,000 private primary and secondary schools, colleges, universities, professional and trade schools if they maintain racial non-discrimination policies

https://www.ag.state.mn.us/Office/Communications/2026/11/06_Edu-Tax-Status.asp
